label: Metric-aligned occupancy-scored 3D-RES baseline

design.encoder: released SPFormer sparse U-Net backbone (loaded with shape-compatible filter)
design.query_score: point-weighted soft IoU between the query's own mask and the occupancy field
design.ranking_loss: pairwise logistic ranking on true per-query IoU, weighted by |IoU difference|

run.dataloader: 2 GPUs x batch 1 = effective batch 2 (published recipe)

diagnostic.conclusion: Mask candidates are strong; the metric-aligned occupancy score is a poor query-ranking function.

conclusion: AdaRES-B0 trained end-to-end and produced strong candidate masks, but its metric-aligned occupancy score selected the wrong query. Close this baseline revision and rebuild with a standard learned indicator before adding metric-aligned evidence.
